info.title: Kiorex Growth API
info.description: Additive in contracts 1.10.0 (PROPOSED, ARCH sections 6 and 8). Public, first-party, consent-aware endpoints of the Kiorex growth module. Rules: no IP address, full user agent, full referrer URL, unknown query parameter, health data, search text, specialty-by-visitor join or provider id in the visitor stream is ever stored; rate limited per rotating ipHash (429 with Retry-After); OFF flag answers 403 FEATURE_DISABLED {key, scope}. The visitor key cookie `kxv` (host-only, Secure, SameSite=Lax, 180 days max) is set only when the request carries `X-KX-Consent: analytics`. v1.1.0 (contracts 1.12.0, additive): public campaign UTM resolve (GET /growth/v1/campaign/resolve: landing target and a campaign token only, never a budget), patient referral endpoints (me, invites, rewards, claim), assistant secure booking link verification, and message-class preference additions. Referral and reward endpoints are launch-locked behind growth.patient_referral and growth.rewards; the assistant link behind kiorex.whatsapp_ai_assistant. Nothing here carries health data. Rev 2.6 additions (still 1.1.0, additive): patient credit endpoints (`/growth/v1/credit`, `/credit/household`, `/rewards/quote`), the refund preview `POST /pay/v1/refunds/preview` and the shared `RefundDestination` enum (the cancel and refund requests of the Kiorex patient API carry an optional `refundDestination`, default ORIGINAL). All credit endpoints are launch-locked behind growth.patient_credit, growth.refund_as_credit and growth.family_credit; rewards never reach a clinic.

post.summary: Record a landing touch (first-party, consent-gated visitor identity)
post.description: Always answers 202 quickly. Without `X-KX-Consent: analytics` nothing is persisted against a visitor key; a valid `lt` is still honoured for the booking in the same session. Unknown keys are dropped (not rejected) except inside `utm`, where an email-like or over-long value rejects the whole call.

parameters.name: X-KX-Consent
parameters.description: Present only after the person accepted analytics/attribution consent.

post.description: Canonical names only. `careType` is allowed; specialty, provider ids, free text and any identifier are rejected. From SlotSelected on, events are server-side operational facts keyed to the booking and are not accepted from the client.

get.summary: Attribution evidence for one booking (ops session or signed partner)
get.description: Facts, not a recomputation: the stored decision, its policy version and the ordered touch references. A partner may read only evidence for its own organisation's bookings. Never returns visitor keys, IP hashes or identifiers.
Public, cacheable for 60 seconds. With one live market the selector flag is false and the client never shows a country picker.

get.summary: Resolve a campaign UTM to its landing target
get.description: Public. Given `utm_campaign` (the value `<market lower case>-<campaign key>`), returns where to send the visitor and an opaque campaign token the client passes back as `utm.campaign` on POST /growth/v1/touch. Only ACTIVE campaigns resolve; anything else (unknown, scheduled, paused, completed, archived) answers 404 `CAMPAIGN_NOT_FOUND`. The answer never contains a budget, a spend figure, a channel list or an eligibility rule.

get.summary: My referral code, status and counts
get.description: Authenticated patient. Returns the person's own code (issued on first call), invite link and counts. 403 FEATURE_DISABLED while growth.patient_referral is not effective.

get.summary: My rewards (coupons or credit) and their status

post.summary: Claim a referral code as the invited person
post.description: Idempotent per invited person: one relationship per person and market. A self-referral, an existing patient or a suspended code is rejected with a machine reason; the reason never reveals who owns the code.

post.summary: Verify a secure booking link sent by the WhatsApp assistant
post.description: Single-use, short-lived link for people whose phone number is not verified (they get search plus a secure link, not booking in chat). Returns where to continue; never the conversation.

put.summary: Change my message-class and channel preferences
put.description: Marketing consent changes are append-only history and take effect at the send gate within 60 seconds. TRANSACTIONAL, SECURITY and CLINICAL messages cannot be switched off here.

get.summary: My credit: open balance and lots with expiry

post.summary: Let a dependant draw from my credit

delete.summary: Stop a member drawing from my credit

post.summary: Checkout lines for a deposit: price, sponsored discount, credit, held deposit, card
Both refund destinations with the exact amounts ('original payment method' preselected)

partnerHmac.name: X-Kiorly-Signature
partnerHmac.description: Kiorly request HMAC (signKiorlyRequest / verifyKiorlyRequest in @kiorex/contracts): X-Kiorly-Client-Key, -Timestamp, -Nonce, -Signature.

patientSession.description: Kiorex Passport patient session (the `sub` is taken from the session, never from the body).

code.description: One of GROWTH_ERROR_CODES, or FEATURE_DISABLED (then also key and scope).

source.description: No spaces, no @ (an email-like value rejects the call), no query punctuation.

medium.description: No spaces, no @ (an email-like value rejects the call), no query punctuation.

campaign.description: No spaces, no @ (an email-like value rejects the call), no query punctuation.

content.description: No spaces, no @ (an email-like value rejects the call), no query punctuation.

term.description: No spaces, no @ (an email-like value rejects the call), no query punctuation.

clickId.description: Hashed on receipt; the raw value is never stored.

ref.description: Provider link code (8 Crockford base32 characters) or patient referral code. Unknown codes are ignored.

lt.description: Signed, short-lived link token issued by the provider's booking page (<= 30 minutes).

dwellMs.description: How long the landing page was actually rendered; a provider touch counts only above the policy minimum.

visitorKeySet.description: True only when consent was present and the kxv cookie was set or refreshed.

name.description: Client-reportable canonical names. SlotSelected, BookingInitiated, BookingConfirmed, BookingAttended, BookingCancelled and PatientRegistered are server-side operational facts and are rejected from clients (GROWTH_EVENT_NOT_ALLOWED).

props.description: Allow-listed keys only; the server rejects specialty, provider ids and PHI-like values.

showMarketSelector.description: False unless more than one market is live (founder rule 23 Nov 2026).

path.description: Site-relative path on the public host, e.g. /ar/eg/doctors?utm_campaign=...

RefundDestination.description: Where a refund of card money goes. Absent means ORIGINAL; CREDIT is an option the patient picks, never a default. Immutable once the refund executed.
